description: This file defines the interface for the IAVBufferHelper class, which provides helper functions for mapping, unmapping, and managing secure buffers identified by handles. It includes method declarations for operations like mapping handles, unmapping, retrieving allocation sizes, writing to secure handles, and copying data between handles. It also declares a factory function to obtain instances of the helper class.

classes.name: IAVBufferHelper
classes.description: An interface class that provides methods for managing shared memory buffers using handles, including mapping, unmapping, size retrieval, writing, and copying operations. It includes a nested struct 'CopyMap' to specify copy parameters.

methods.name: mapHandle
methods.description: Maps memory from a given handle and returns a pointer to the mapped memory, also providing its size.

methods.name: unmapHandle
methods.description: Unmaps memory associated with a given handle, returning true if successful.

methods.name: getAllocationSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the memory allocated to the specified handle.

methods.name: bool writeSecureHandle(uint64_t handle,void * data,uint32_t size)
methods.description: Writes data into a secure buffer identified by handle; defaults to returning false, indicating not implemented.

methods.name: bool copySecureHandleWithMap(uint64_t handleTo,uint64_t handleFrom,CopyMap map,uint32_t mapSize)
methods.description: Copies data between secure buffers using a specified mapping; defaults to returning false.

ctags.name: copySecureHandleWithMap
ctags.pattern: /^    virtual bool copySecureHandleWithMap(uint64_t handleTo, uint64_t handleFrom, CopyMap map, ui/

ctags.name: writeSecureHandle
ctags.pattern: /^    virtual bool writeSecureHandle(uint64_t handle, void* data, uint32_t size) { return false; }$/
